groups.title: Look Up
groups.note: Wonder, passed from person to person. 1: two kids point up at the Atomium. 2: a man raises his arm to a kite between the towers. 3: a couple stands close under a needle with a giant insect on top. 4: indoors, a whole crowd tilts their heads to a painted ceiling. One child's finger, then everyone.

groups.title: Held
groups.note: The small in the hands of the big, from holding to letting go. 1: a father bends down to take a toddler's hand on the lakeside path. 2: a man carries his son, the boy's face pressed into his shoulder, a dog riding in a backpack beside them. 3: at a concert, a mother hugs her child, a grandmother films, a girl rides on her father's shoulders. 4: a mother steers a stroller through a crowd of strangers' backs; the toddler, pacifier in mouth, sees only legs and caps. 5: a child rides ahead on a scooter, the parent's cargo bike now behind. Letting go.

groups.title: A Child's City
groups.note: The world at child height. 1: from the dark of a shop, a child climbs into the open boot of a car outside, the doorway framing it like a stage. 2: a toddler stands before a stone giant while her mother bends to her. 3: two boys study a stranger's drawings laid out on a park bench. 4: a girl pushes herself up the ramp to join the boys sitting on top. 5: in the Galleria, adults kneel to photograph the architecture while a little girl in her stroller stretches, completely bored. Read it after 'Held'.

groups.title: Watching Them Pass
groups.note: Old age watching youth go by, ending in memory. 1: a woman with her small dog watches two boys chase a ball across the square. 2: an old woman stops to watch a small boy cross a white courtyard. 3: two young men stride past, heads high, while an old woman in a wheelchair watches from a café table and pigeons wander at our feet. 4: old men sit shoulder to shoulder watching their own game, bocce. 5: in a dark museum an old man walks past a painting of a young girl standing in a doorway, his head bowed. The girl she was, or the girl he knew.

groups.title: Alone Among Others
groups.note: Loneliness inside the crowd, from day into night. 1: one chef leans alone on the balcony above while his colleagues embrace and laugh below. 2: a young man sits by himself on the castle lawn, looking back. 3: a man waits against a shutter while young people blur past. 4: at night, behind glass, two young men sit facing each other wearing VR headsets, each in another world, while two girls sit outside the window lit by their phones. 5: at a concert, a man watches two women dance; close to their joy, but outside it. Read 'Company' right after.

groups.title: Company
groups.note: The answer to 'Alone Among Others': real attention to another person. 1: two men stand side by side at a lake railing, silently watching a boat. 2: under a castle arcade, a man directs a woman's pose for a photo, his shadow on the wall reaching towards her. 3: two people lie head to head on the edge of the castle moat, laughing up at the sky. 4: three young women laugh together under a bronze horseman. 5: on the steps, couples dance.

groups.title: Under the Billboards
groups.note: Real people beneath the images made for them. 1: a street sweeper pushes his barrow under glowing shop signs. 2: a man hauls cardboard beneath a model checking her luxury watch. 3: a mother pulls her little girl away from a giant shoe she wants to stay and look at, under a billboard face. 4: a crowd stands fenced in under a giant laughing face. 5: a painted boy holds his head in his hands while real people walk past without looking.

groups.title: Curious
groups.note: Grown-ups becoming children again. 1: a man pokes his head into a dark doorway. 2: people push their heads into a porthole to see what's inside. 3: faces appear in a narrow slit. 4: a woman crouches in an opening, peeking out like a kid playing hide and seek. 5: a man waves at the camera while someone hides in the photo booth beside him.

groups.title: Passage
groups.note: Walking into the unknown. Quiet, almost spiritual. 1: two girls in First Communion veils walk through a dark gate towards the castle. 2: a lone figure waits under an arch in the rain. 3: small figures cross a strip of light between dark walls. 4: under a grey sky a woman in a headscarf walks along an old stone wall while men sit looking out over the plain and grazing sheep. 5: four figures walk down a road into thick fog as birds rise beside them. From a gate to the open, from a ritual to the unknown.

groups.title: Shared Ground
groups.note: Strangers sharing the same piece of city. 1: from a tram, strangers wait together at a stop. 2: an old woman walks across a square while children play football under the arcades. 3: people share the sun outside a jazz café. 4: small groups sit along the river's edge. 5: a couple takes a selfie while three friends sit with their legs over the canal.

groups.title: Left Behind
groups.note: What people leave, and the absence it shows. 1: children's bikes dropped in the middle of a square as pigeons fly over. 2: a crowd gathers around bicycles lying on the street. 3: two men rest on a statue's base beside a pair of shoes someone left there. 4: a pair of sneakers hangs by its laces from the corner of a roof against an empty sky. The people are gone; their traces stay.

groups.title: Small Joys
groups.note: Colour. Private happinesses. 1: an old man stops beside a yellow rose bush while others picnic. 2: a small child walks along the edge of the Como fountain. 3: a girl carries red and blue balloons through the crowd. 4: a man crouches to play with his dog under the vertical forest. 5: dancers in gold and white saris perform beside the Duomo's marble walls.

groups.title: Watching Us
groups.note: Who is looking at whom. 1: a puppy tucked in a coat watches legs walk past. 2: women at a luxury window; one hides her face behind her phone, another stares at the mannequin. 3: a man's head peeks over a wall below a glittering chandelier. 4: a woman sits on a bollard under a painted woman. 5: a toy unicorn looks out of a shop window at the street.
